paragraphs: Rav Meri son of Rav Kahana: Beitzah 7a; Sotah 30b; Bava Kamma 23a, 44b, 91a; Zevaḥim 55a; Bekhorot 12, 33b. She'erit Yosef counted him among Rav's students. I do not know where he obtained this, since his father Rav Kahana was Rav's student.
